title: H0527 (2022 Regular): Unfinished Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2021-11-08; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2022/527/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2448346))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2021-11-08); no passage vote. Quotes keep the printed typo 'is r imprinted'. Penalty subsections (b) omitted for length.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new s. 790.223, F.S.): (2)(a) After January 1, 2023, a person may not possess, purchase, transport, or receive an unfinished frame or receiver unless: 1. The person is a firearms importer or manufacturer; or 2. The unfinished frame or receiver is imprinted with a serial number issued by a firearms importer or manufacturer and the unfinished frame or receiver has been imprinted with the serial number pursuant to federal law.
Section 1 (new s. 790.223, F.S.): (3)(a) A person may not sell, offer to sell, or transfer an unfinished frame or receiver unless: 1. The person is a firearms importer or manufacturer and the recipient of the unfinished frame or receiver is a firearms importer or manufacturer; or 2. The unfinished frame or receiver is r imprinted with a serial number issued by an importer or manufacturer and the unfinished frame or receiver has been imprinted with the serial number pursuant to federal law.
Section 1 (new s. 790.223, F.S.): (4)(a) A person may not manufacture or cause to be manufactured or assemble or cause to be assembled a firearm that is not imprinted with a serial number issued by a firearms importer or manufacturer in accordance with federal law and any regulations adopted thereunder unless the firearm: 1. Has been rendered permanently inoperable; 2. Is an antique firearm; or 3. Has been determined to be a collector's item pursuant to 26 U.S.C. chapter 53 or a curio or relic pursuant to 18 U.S.C. chapter 44.
Section 1 (new s. 790.223, F.S.): (5)(a) After January 1, 2023, a person may not possess, sell, offer to sell, transfer, purchase, transport or receive a firearm that is not imprinted with a serial number issued by a firearms importer or manufacturer in accordance with federal law and any regulations adopted thereunder unless: 1. The person is: a. A law enforcement agency; or b. A firearms importer or manufacturer, and in the case of an offer to sell, sale, or transfer, the purchaser or transferee is a firearms importer or manufacturer; or 2. The firearm: a. Has been rendered permanently inoperable; b. Was manufactured before 1969; c. Is an antique firearm; or d. Has been determined to be a collector's item pursuant to 26 U.S.C. chapter 53 or a curio or relic pursuant to 18 U.S.C. chapter 44.
